# BLO-40736 — give `source-map-js` a durable `overrides` floor, not just a resolved pin

Changed files:

- `package.json` — `overrides` gains `"source-map-js": ">=1.2.2 <2"`, alongside the
  existing `"js-yaml": ">=4.3.2 <5"` entry and in the same form.

`package-lock.json` is **not** changed by this, and that is the expected result,
not an omission: npm does not write an `overrides` block into `packages[""]`
here (the `js-yaml` override is absent from the lockfile too), and the resolved
`source-map-js` is already `1.2.2` from the sibling commit on this branch, which
satisfies the new range. `npm install --package-lock-only` reproduces the
lockfile byte-identically, and `npm ci --include=dev` still resolves 1.2.2.

Why the floor is worth adding when the pin already reads 1.2.2: the pin is a
*resolved* version, and nothing holds it. Both consumers today (`magicast`,
`postcss`) declare `^1.2.1`, so a regeneration happens to land on 1.2.2 — but a
future transitive declaring `1.2.1` or `~1.2.1` would resolve straight back into
the GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q range with nothing to stop it. This directory is also
deliberately excluded from Dependabot (see `.github/dependabot.yml`), so there
is no automated alert-to-bump path that would re-flag it; remediation here has
already been done by hand twice — js-yaml under BLO-32908 (`91b1c8cca`), which
added the very `">=4.3.2 <5"` override cited above, and now this one. The floor
is what makes the second the last, and it is the same remedy both times.

No upstream change: `overrides` is a Blockcast-local addition to the vendored
manifest, not a carried patch against an upstream adapter release.
